preconditions.expression: all(3 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in [n, m]) and 2 <= k <= n - 1
preconditions.description: Input constraints: n and m are between 3 and 10^5, and k is between 2 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n and int(a) != int(b) for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (a_i, b_i) connects distinct nodes within the valid range [1, n].
The input contains exactly m edges, with no duplicates or self-loops.

preconditions.expression: all(len(adj_list) >= k for adj_list in adjacency_lists)
preconditions.description: Every node has degree at least k, where adjacency_lists is the adjacency list representation of the graph.

postconditions.expression: len(cycle) >= k + 1 and all(1 <= v <= n for v in cycle)
postconditions.description: The output cycle has length at least k+1, and all nodes in the cycle are valid (1 ≤ v_i ≤ n).

postconditions.expression: all((cycle[i] == cycle[i+1] or (cycle[i], cycle[i+1]) in edges or (cycle[i+1], cycle[i]) in edges) for i in range(len(cycle)-1)) and ((cycle[0], cycle[-1]) in edges or (cycle[-1], cycle[0]) in edges)
postconditions.description: The cycle is simple (all nodes distinct) and edges exist between consecutive nodes and between the first and last node.
The cycle contains no repeated nodes (simple cycle).
